description: A block confirming a game action is orphaned by a competing chain. Per spec/ordering-rules.md §5 the indexer rewinds to the deepest common ancestor and forward-applies the new chain, reporting which actions were orphaned. The pure engine is reorg-agnostic; chain.Reindex drives the replay.
notes: Consumed by apps/relay-go/tests/adversarial/vectors_test.go driving the real chain.Reindex.
